sentences.english: What colour is your car?
sentences.chinese: 你的车是什么颜色的？
sentences.scene: 闲聊时问起对方车子的颜色

sentences.english: I love the colour of the sky just before the sun goes down.
sentences.chinese: 我特别喜欢日落前天空的颜色。
sentences.scene: 欣赏傍晚天空时的感叹

sentences.english: We spent an hour arguing about what colour to paint the living room, and we ended up choosing a light grey that everyone hates.
sentences.chinese: 我们花了一个小时争论客厅刷什么颜色，最后选了一种浅灰色，结果大家都不喜欢。
sentences.scene: 家庭装修选颜色时的争吵

sentences.english: She wore a bright orange dress.
sentences.chinese: 她穿了一件亮橙色的连衣裙。
sentences.scene: 描述别人醒目的穿着

sentences.english: The leaves turn orange and red every autumn in our neighborhood.
sentences.chinese: 每年秋天我们街区的树叶都会变成橙色和红色。
sentences.scene: 谈论季节变化带来的景色

sentences.english: I wanted to dye my hair orange for the concert, but my mom talked me out of it and I ended up with just an orange streak instead.
sentences.chinese: 我本想为演唱会染个橙色头发，但我妈劝住了我，最后我只挑染了一缕橙色。
sentences.scene: 一时冲动想染夸张发色又被劝住的经历

sentences.english: I like your green backpack.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你的绿色背包。
sentences.scene: 看到同学的新书包随口夸奖

sentences.english: The salad is mostly green, but it has some tomatoes and carrots.
sentences.chinese: 这份沙拉大部分是绿色的，但里面有些番茄和胡萝卜。
sentences.scene: 描述午餐沙拉的内容

sentences.english: When the traffic light turned green, the car in front of me didn't move, so I gently honked and the driver waved an apology.
sentences.chinese: 当交通信号灯变绿时，我前面的车没动，于是我轻轻按了下喇叭，那位司机挥手表示歉意。
sentences.scene: 路口等红灯变绿时的小插曲

sentences.english: The stop sign is red.
sentences.chinese: 停车标志是红色的。
sentences.scene: 教小孩认识交通标志

sentences.english: I love wearing red lipstick when I go out with friends.
sentences.chinese: 和朋友出去玩时我喜欢涂红色口红。
sentences.scene: 分享化妆的小爱好

sentences.english: I spilled red wine on my new white shirt at the party, and I spent the rest of the night trying to hide the stain with a jacket.
sentences.chinese: 派对上我把红酒洒在了新的白衬衫上，结果整个晚上我都用外套遮着那块污渍。
sentences.scene: 社交场合的尴尬小意外

sentences.english: The sky is so blue today.
sentences.chinese: 今天天空真蓝。
sentences.scene: 天气好时抬头看天

sentences.english: He's been feeling a little blue since his best friend moved away.
sentences.chinese: 自从最好的朋友搬走后，他一直有点闷闷不乐。
sentences.scene: 关心朋友的情绪状态

sentences.english: I painted my room a soft blue because I heard it helps you sleep better, and honestly, I've been sleeping like a baby ever since.
sentences.chinese: 我把房间刷成了柔和的蓝色，因为听说这样有助睡眠，老实说，从那以后我睡得特别香。
sentences.scene: 用颜色改善睡眠质量的尝试

sentences.english: Let's make a cake for Dad.
sentences.chinese: 我们给爸爸做个蛋糕吧。
sentences.scene: 孩子提议为爸爸准备惊喜

sentences.english: Could you make me a cup of coffee, please?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我冲杯咖啡吗？
sentences.scene: 早上请家人帮忙做咖啡

sentences.english: Watching that funny video really made my day; I was in such a bad mood before, and now I can't stop smiling.
sentences.chinese: 看了那个搞笑视频真让我开心了一整天，之前心情还很差，现在笑得停不下来。
sentences.scene: 一个搞笑视频改变心情的瞬间

sentences.english: She has a purple pencil case.
sentences.chinese: 她有一个紫色的铅笔盒。
sentences.scene: 观察同学的文具

sentences.english: The sky turned a beautiful shade of purple after the storm.
sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，天空变成了一种美丽的紫色。
sentences.scene: 雨后傍晚的迷人天色

sentences.english: My grandma's favourite colour was purple, so every time I see a purple flower, it reminds me of her garden and the time we spent together.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶最喜欢的颜色是紫色，所以每次看到紫色的花，我都会想起她的花园和我们一起度过的时光。
sentences.scene: 睹物思人的温情回忆

sentences.english: He has brown eyes.
sentences.chinese: 他有一双棕色的眼睛。
sentences.scene: 描述某人的外貌特征

sentences.english: I'll have a brown sugar latte, please.
sentences.chinese: 我要一杯红糖拿铁，谢谢。
sentences.scene: 在咖啡店点单

sentences.english: I tried to bake brownies for the first time, and the edges got a little too brown, but the middle was still soft and delicious.
sentences.chinese: 我第一次尝试烤布朗尼，边上烤得有点焦黄了，但中间还是又软又好吃。
sentences.scene: 分享烘焙的小翻车与成功

sentences.english: I saw a bear on TV.
sentences.chinese: 我在电视上看到一只熊。
sentences.scene: 孩子说起在纪录片里看到的动物

sentences.english: We had to be careful with our food while camping because of bears.
sentences.chinese: 露营时我们得小心存放食物，因为有熊出没。
sentences.scene: 交流露营时的安全注意事项

sentences.english: When we were driving through the mountains, a black bear crossed the road right in front of us, and we just sat there in silence, completely amazed.
sentences.chinese: 我们开车穿过山区时，一只黑熊就在我们车前横穿马路，我们静静地坐在车里，完全被震撼到了。
sentences.scene: 在野外与熊近距离邂逅的难忘经历

sentences.english: She drives a yellow car.
sentences.chinese: 她开一辆黄色的车。
sentences.scene: 描述某人的车子颜色

sentences.english: I love how the yellow leaves look in the fall sunshine.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢黄色树叶在秋日阳光下的样子。
sentences.scene: 欣赏秋天景色

sentences.english: I put on a bright yellow raincoat this morning because the forecast said it would pour, and of course, it turned out to be sunny all day.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我穿了一件亮黄色雨衣，因为天气预报说会下大雨，结果当然是一整天都大晴天。
sentences.scene: 被天气预报忽悠的尴尬经历

sentences.english: Look at the ducks in the pond!
sentences.chinese: 看池塘里的鸭子！
sentences.scene: 逛公园时指着水面上

sentences.english: We fed the ducks some old bread at the lake yesterday.
sentences.chinese: 昨天我们在湖边用一些旧面包喂了鸭子。
sentences.scene: 周末湖边的亲子活动

sentences.english: A mama duck and her little ducklings crossed the busy road, and all the cars just stopped and waited until they were safely on the other side.
sentences.chinese: 一只鸭妈妈带着一群小鸭子横穿繁忙的马路，所有的车都停下来等着，直到它们安全走到另一边。
sentences.scene: 路上遇到鸭子一家过马路的暖心一幕

sentences.english: I can hear the sea from here.
sentences.chinese: 我从这里能听到海的声音。
sentences.scene: 走近海边时的感慨

sentences.english: We spent our vacation by the sea, swimming every single day.
sentences.chinese: 我们在海边度过了假期，每天都会去游泳。
sentences.scene: 描述惬意的海边假期

sentences.english: The sea was so clear that we could see little fish swimming around our feet, and I wished I had brought an underwater camera.
sentences.chinese: 海水清澈得能看见小鱼在我们脚边游来游去，我真后悔没带水下相机。
sentences.scene: 清澈海水带来的惊喜与遗憾

sentences.english: Can I have some water?
sentences.chinese: 我能喝点水吗？
sentences.scene: 在家或餐厅提出请求

sentences.english: I need to buy some milk and eggs on the way home.
sentences.chinese: 我回家路上得买些牛奶和鸡蛋。
sentences.scene: 心里默念购物清单

sentences.english: I baked some cookies for the school bake sale, but my brother ate half of them before I even left the house.
sentences.chinese: 我为学校义卖烤了些饼干，可我还没出门，弟弟就吃掉了一半。
sentences.scene: 辛苦准备的东西被家人偷吃

sentences.english: She painted her nails pink.
sentences.chinese: 她把指甲涂成了粉红色。
sentences.scene: 注意到朋友的新美甲

sentences.english: My little sister insists that everything she owns has to be pink.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹坚持她所有的东西都必须是粉红色的。
sentences.scene: 吐槽妹妹对粉色的执着

sentences.english: I ordered a pink sweater online, but when it arrived, it was more like a neon pink, which was way brighter than I expected.
sentences.chinese: 我在网上订了一件粉色毛衣，但收到后才发现那是荧光粉，比我预想的亮太多了。
sentences.scene: 网购色差带来的哭笑不得

sentences.english: Can you draw a cat?
sentences.chinese: 你会画猫吗？
sentences.scene: 小朋友之间互相问

sentences.english: My daughter loves to draw pictures of our family and our dog.
sentences.chinese: 我女儿喜欢画我们的家人和狗。
sentences.scene: 展示孩子的涂鸦作品

sentences.english: I used to draw on the back of my notebooks during class, and one time my teacher caught me, but she just smiled and said I had a gift.
sentences.chinese: 我以前上课时在笔记本背面画画，有一次被老师抓到了，但她只是笑了笑，说我很有天赋。
sentences.scene: 回忆学生时代在课上偷画画的经历

sentences.english: I love your white shoes.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你的白鞋。
sentences.scene: 夸奖朋友的新鞋

sentences.english: The whole garden was covered in white snow this morning.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上整个花园都被白雪覆盖了。
sentences.scene: 描述下雪后的美景

sentences.english: I bought a white couch thinking it would look elegant, but with two kids and a dog, it was a terrible decision.
sentences.chinese: 我买了一张白色沙发，本以为会很雅致，但有两个孩子和一条狗，这真是个糟糕的决定。
sentences.scene: 有娃有宠物后对白色家具的后悔

sentences.english: He was wearing a black hat.
sentences.chinese: 他戴着一顶黑色的帽子。
sentences.scene: 描述某人的装扮

sentences.english: Most of my clothes are black because it's just easier to match.
sentences.chinese: 我大部分衣服都是黑色的，因为这样更好搭配。
sentences.scene: 解释自己穿衣风格的原因

sentences.english: I walked into a black coffee table in the middle of the night because I didn't turn on the light, and now my shin has a huge bruise.
sentences.chinese: 半夜我没开灯，结果撞上了黑色的茶几，现在小腿上青了一大块。
sentences.scene: 半夜摸黑撞到家具的惨痛经历
